description: This file defines a factory function to create CRUD controllers for Mongoose models with tenant enforcement, including utilities for sorting, pagination, caching, and error handling.

methods.name: validateSort
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes sort string against allowed fields to prevent heavy sorts.

methods.name: clampLimit
methods.description: Enforces maximum page size limit for safety.

methods.name: microGet
methods.description: Retrieves a value from in-memory micro-cache if not expired.

methods.name: microSet
methods.description: Sets a value in in-memory micro-cache with TTL.

methods.name: buildListKey
methods.description: Builds a stable cache key for list requests based on request parameters.

methods.name: sanitizePayloadWithTenant
methods.description: Sanitizes request payloads for create/update, injecting tenantId.

methods.name: mergeFilterWithTenant
methods.description: Merges filter with enforced tenantId, ignoring client-supplied tenant keys.

methods.name: mapAndReplyError
methods.description: Maps Mongoose errors to user-friendly HTTP responses.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles listing documents with tenant enforcement, filtering, sorting, pagination, caching, and error handling.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a single document by ID with tenant enforcement.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new document after sanitizing payload and enforcing tenant.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a document by ID with tenant enforcement.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a document by ID with tenant enforcement.
